entries.zh: 设置会保存，下次启动继续生效。

entries.zh: 切换为 MR 透视背景

entries.en: Take a breath. The encounter is paused.
Resume when the headset is active.
entries.zh: 头显恢复追踪后可继续。

entries.zh: 获得 {0} 碎片  /  累计 {1}

entries.en: Aim with either hand. Pinch to select, then pinch CONFIRM.
entries.zh: 用任一手的食指瞄准，捏合选择，再瞄准「确认」并捏合。

entries.en: Choose a connected route. Your next encounter begins after confirmation.
entries.zh: 选择相连的路线，确认后开始下一场挑战。

entries.en: Choose one inscription to carry into the next encounter.
entries.zh: 选择一件遗物，带入下一场挑战。

entries.en: Your rite evolves after each cleared encounter.
entries.zh: 每次通关后，所选仪式都会成长。

entries.en: You carry {0} shards. Confirm a purchase, removal, or departure.
entries.zh: 你持有 {0} 碎片。选择购买、移除或离开，再确认。
花费 {0} 碎片，返还 1 碎片

entries.en: Bleed for power, or walk away unharmed?
entries.zh: 以鲜血换取力量，还是安然离开？

entries.en: A fast horizontal swipe throws an energy wave.
entries.zh: 快速水平挥动右手，释放能量波。

entries.en: Use both hands. Keep the kill chain alive.
entries.zh: 配合双手攻击，保持连续击杀。

entries.en: Prioritize ranged Weavers and break the Tanks.
entries.zh: 优先击败远程织影者，再击破重甲敌人。
得分 {0}  |  击败 {1} 个敌人

entries.en: Use Restart to run it again.
entries.zh: 选择重新开始，可再次挑战。

entries.en: Hold an enemy in the blue cone to chain lightning.
entries.zh: 让敌人保持在蓝色锥形区域内，释放连锁闪电。

entries.en: Single-target spear. Waves pierce through enemies and hit harder, but fire slower.
entries.zh: 单体长枪：能量波穿透敌人，伤害更高，攻击频率较低。

entries.en: Spread fan. Fires faster with extra projectiles, trading raw damage for crowd control.
entries.zh: 风暴散射：增加投射物与攻击频率，以单发伤害换取群体压制。

entries.en: Defensive bulwark. Reduces incoming damage at the cost of slightly slower waves.
entries.zh: 守护壁垒：减少受到的伤害，代价是能量波速度略慢。

entries.en: Splinter of caged wind. Hands fire faster.
entries.zh: 囚风的碎片，提高双手攻击频率。

entries.en: Etched with the names of the fallen. When you tip toward death, their fury floods you.
entries.zh: 刻有亡者之名的护符。濒死时，亡者之怒将涌入你的体内。

entries.en: An oath written in obsidian. Each fallen foe turns the next blow heavier.
entries.zh: 刻在黑曜石上的誓言。每击败一个敌人，下一击都会更强。

entries.en: Two embers braided into one. Each beam multiplies.
entries.zh: 两缕余烬交织成一体，使每道能量束分裂增生。

entries.en: A scale plucked from the sea-keeper. Stitches a wound for every three slain.
entries.zh: 取自海洋守卫的鳞片，每击败三个敌人恢复生命。

entries.en: A circlet of brambles. Each cut tightens the grip and quickens the next strike.
entries.zh: 荆棘编成的冠冕。每次受伤都会加快下一次攻击。

entries.en: A gauntlet that breaks every world it strikes. A sharp jolt of damage on pickup.
entries.zh: 足以击碎世界的拳套。拾取后立即大幅提升伤害。

entries.en: A weight of mountains in the palm. Every shot lands harder.
entries.zh: 群山之重凝于掌心，每次攻击都造成更高伤害。

entries.en: A halo of bound starlight. Every dozen kills births a new beam.
entries.zh: 束缚星光的圆环，每击败十二个敌人增加一道能量束。

entries.en: A feather sheared from a storm. Hands beat to a quicker tempo.
entries.zh: 从风暴中飘落的羽毛，加快双手的攻击节奏。

entries.en: Each kill quickens the next. Stack speed forever.
entries.zh: 每次击杀提高攻击频率，持续累积。

entries.en: Eight kills, and another shard of light splits from your palm.
entries.zh: 每击败八个敌人，掌心便分裂出另一道光。

entries.en: A smoldering ember bound in iron. Every shot lands heavier.
entries.zh: 锁于铁中的炽热余烬，提高每次攻击的伤害。

entries.en: Resonates with each blow taken, hands surge with quickening rage.
entries.zh: 每次受伤都会引发共鸣，以愤怒提高双手攻击频率。

entries.en: A lantern that ignites only at the edge of death. The first time you fall under thirty percent health, the light surges.
entries.zh: 只在濒死时点亮的灯。生命首次降至 30% 以下时，释放强烈光芒。

entries.en: A crimson tooth that drinks essence. Damage rises with every kill.
entries.zh: 汲取精华的赤红獠牙，每次击杀都会提高伤害。

entries.en: Pale silver pendant. Mends a wound for every five kills.
entries.zh: 苍银色的吊坠，每击败五个敌人恢复生命。

entries.en: Faceted glass that splits each beam in two.
entries.zh: 多面的玻璃棱晶，使每道能量束一分为二。

entries.en: A book that tallies vanquished foes. Each closed wave inks heavier strikes.
entries.zh: 记录战果的账簿，每肃清一波敌人都会提高伤害。

entries.en: A dark sigil that drinks the breath of the slain. Each kill sharpens hands further.
entries.zh: 吞噬亡者气息的暗印，每次击杀都让双手更为锋利。

entries.en: Time deepens the strike. Every cleared wave thickens your damage.
entries.zh: 时间淬炼攻击，每肃清一波敌人都会提升伤害。

entries.en: Look at a choice. Pinch either hand, release, then look at CONFIRM and pinch.
entries.zh: 注视选项，任意一只手捏合选择；松开后注视「确认」，再次捏合。

entries.en: Eye tracking unavailable. Aim with your head and pinch either hand.
entries.zh: 眼动追踪暂不可用。转头瞄准选项，任意一只手捏合确认。
